dimensions.scoring: Count of implemented requirements / total requirements. Partial implementations score 0.5.
Module boundaries respected, no circular deps, shared types centralized, cross-module contracts consistent.
Lower is better. Each P0 defect = -5, P1 = -2, P2 = -1. Testing coverage counts positively.
Loading/empty/error/success states, error handling, input validation, consistent patterns.
Time-to-completion. Additional time vs Vanilla baseline. Human intervention count. Context resets.
SHA256 manifests, verifier PASS, transcripts, close receipts. v0.5 additionally: agent registry completeness, anti-deception clean.

scoringMethod: Weighted sum, normalized to 0-100. Each dimension scored independently by evaluator.
